experiment: NIST StRD Longley linear least squares (7 parameters, 16 observations, higher difficulty)

inputs.note: Data lines 61-76 are the regression input; certified values repeat in lines 31-51. CRLF bytes kept as served.
Certified values page, source of certified.json. It embeds a per-request Cloudflare token, so a fresh fetch differs in bytes; compare the values, not the hash.
Dataset landing page (reference and links); same per-request token caveat.

environment.declared_in: requirements.txt (pins the reference numpy 2.3.5; also needed by the repository test run, tests/test_nist_longley.py)
environment.reference: Python 3.12.14 and numpy 2.3.5 with scipy-openblas 0.3.30, the same build strings as the bundled Codex runtime Python that scripts/check.ps1 selects on the reference host; how numpy was installed into it is not recorded
environment.recorded_per_run: results/run.json (Python, numpy, BLAS/LAPACK build, platform, input and output sha256, cond2(X))

outputs: draft/section.tex (cites draft/references.bib; every decimal gated against results/lstsq.csv only, never the control)
threshold_rationale: Declared in this manifest. The repository history cannot show that it preceded the comparison: the threshold, the results and the checks entered together in commit bb99a59. Basis: a backward-stable float64 least-squares solve is guaranteed only about -log10(cond2(X) * eps) = 5.97 digits for this design matrix (cond2(X) = 4.859e9), floored to 5. That bound is normwise; check.py applies it to each value, where it is a heuristic, not a guarantee. Kept after the normal-equations control passed: no verified literature threshold above 5 was found, and a value chosen between the observed minima (7.41 and 10.93) would tune the verdict.

control.role: Informational comparison of solvers. Never an acceptance verdict and never the failed check; a FAIL on another BLAS/LAPACK is an environment difference of the control as long as lstsq passes.
control.note: The naive normal equations were expected to fail (cond2(X'X) = cond2(X)^2 = 2.361e19 > 1/eps; numpy's cond of the computed X'X reads 2.384e19 because that matrix is numerically singular in float64) but reached min LRE 7.41 in the reference run. The column-scaled cond2(X) = 4.328e4 predicts about 6.4 digits for them and 11.0 for the SVD solve (observed 10.93): the unscaled worst-case bound was pessimistic. Their per-value LREs stay in results/check-normal-equations.json.

retained_failed_check.case: draft/section-mutated.tex: the manuscript claim 'a residual standard deviation of 304.8541' altered by one digit to 304.8542
retained_failed_check.expected: exit 1 with exactly one unmatched numeral, 304.8542: the facts gate rejects the mutated manuscript claim
